node: Inspection, metrology, yield management, and process-control tools for advanced nodes, HBM, packaging, and PCBs
summary: Layer 1B expands the US-listed universe around semiconductor process control. KLA is the reference leader and context anchor. The underfollowed lane focuses on smaller US-listed or Nasdaq-listed suppliers with inspection, metrology, advanced packaging, HBM, and yield-control exposure: Onto Innovation, Camtek, and Nova. The core inference is that AI accelerators, HBM, chiplets, and advanced packaging increase defect cost and process complexity, raising demand for inspection/metrology intensity across wafers, packages, substrates, and manufacturing flows.
